Mobile app 4.2 release plan
===========================

Background
----------
Release 4.2 moves sign-in to passkeys and rebuilds the order history screen.
It ships to both stores in the same week.

Code freeze
-----------
Feature branches merge by Friday; after that only fixes for P1 defects go in.

Smoke and regression (1 week)
-----------------------------
The device lab runs the smoke pack on every nightly build, then the full
regression on the freeze build:

1. Install the build on the twelve reference devices
2. Run the passkey sign-in journeys
3. Run the order history regression pack

Done when: no P1 defects are open and the crash-free rate is above 99.5%

Beta with pilot users (2 weeks)
-------------------------------
TestFlight and the Play internal track, 400 pilot users.

Store release
-------------
Phased rollout to 100% of users over 7 days.
